messages:
maria: Quick heads up — we want to deprecate the long `X-Redwood-Route` header and introduce a compact `x-rd-route` token (base64-ish short form) to reduce header size impacts and make routing parsing uniform across SDKs. Opening this thread to coordinate SDK changes + console/telemetry mapping. PR: github.com/redwood/rfcs/pull/82

kevin: Question — will older clients blindly error or fallback? we have embedded devices + air-gapped infra using the old header.

maria: Good call. Plan is server-side to accept both for 3 months, but SDKs should switch to emitting `x-rd-route` on the next minor. Server logs will emit a deprecation metric when long header seen.

sylvia: For console: we currently key quota and per-route dashboards by the decoded route segments from the long header. We need a deterministic canonicalization step so both formats map to the same route label. Otherwise quota attribution splits.

jonathan: +1. Can we add a canonical route id in spans/telemetry? e.g., `route.id` tag that the routing layer writes after decoding either header. Then UI and quota ledger can use `route.id`.

maria: Yes — routing layer will emit `route.id` (stable string) and `route.raw_header_variant` (values: long|compact) for a transition window. That helps console dashboards and audit.

kevin: SDK impact: Python/TS/Go will need to change client lib to send compact by default and include a compatibility opt-out. We should list exact bump semantics so customers don't get surprised.

maria: Proposal: patch bump that toggles on `x-rd-route` by default for new major of SDK? hmm. Maybe minor with opt-in first, then remove opt-out after 2 minors. Thoughts?

jonathan: I prefer a minor release with opt-in flag (env var / ClientConfig). Then 1. a canary rollout where Redwood hosted sets `route_canonicalization=true` for a subset of traffic to validate metrics. 2. After 6 weeks, flip default in a minor.

sylvia: For telemetry dashboards, we need a migration script that remaps historical rows keyed by the long header to `route.id`. Otherwise historical charts look broken. Ops, will that be easy?

maria: We'll add a migration job that runs in the metrics pipeline to rewrite old keys. It won't be instantaneous, but we can backfill. We'll also annotate the console with a banner for the migration window.

kevin: Example change in Python SDK — snippet for reviewers: 
```python
# old
headers = {"X-Redwood-Route": "env:service:shard-1"}
# new
headers = {"x-rd-route": "Z2VuOnNlcnZpY2U6czE="}  # compact encoded token
client.request(..., headers=headers)
```

jonathan: TS/Go examples needed too. Also update the changelogs and the migration guide in devportal. Devex to draft.

maria: Action items I propose:
- devex: draft migration guide + example snippets (py/ts/go) — @kevin volunteer?
- eng-platform: implement `route.id` emission + deprecation metric — @jonathan
- console: add banner + dataset migration job — @sylvia
- infra: accept both headers for 3 months and enable canary for 5% traffic first — ops/infra

kevin: I can take the devex guide + snippets. I'll open a draft PR with examples and a compatibility section.

jonathan: I'll start the platform change. Plan: add `route.id` to internal trace envelope and a metric `route_header_variant.count` with tag variant=long|compact. Will run canary in staging tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline kicked: platform/router-service -> canary on staging (build 2024.9.3) at 2024-07-18T14:02:00Z

sylvia: For the console migration job I'll sketch a backfill query. We should also add a manual override in UI to map a decoded route to a tenant alias in case of conflicts.

maria: Nice. Timeline suggestion: Week 0: announce + guide. Week 1–3: SDK opt-in releases and canary. Week 4–8: flip default in SDK minor, enable server-side deprecation metric and console backfill. Week 9–12: remove long-header acceptance if no major breakage.

kevin: One more: telemetry quotas. When both headers are present, server should prefer canonical `route.id` for quota ledger. Confirm?

jonathan: Affirmative. Quota allocator will read `route.id` (if present) else decode header. That'll avoid double counting.

maria: OK — I'll capture these notes and make the RFC checklist updates. Thanks all — please post PR links here when ready.

kevin: PR: github.com/redwood/devex/pulls/1234 (draft migration guide).

jonathan: PR: github.com/redwood/platform/pulls/9876 (route.id emission, tests).

sylvia: Filed UX ticket for console banner + mapping UI: internal/UX-452.

maria: Great — leaving this thread open for any last-minute gotchas. :thumbsup:
